label: TP
reason: Both alerts are verified as true positives. Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value is rememberMeKey derived from java.util.Random.nextGaussian(), which is cryptographically weak for session token generation. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value includes user-controlled cookie data (rememberMe.getValue()) printed directly to HTML response without encoding. Both vulnerabilities represent actual security risks.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness source: java.util.Random.nextGaussian() used for rememberMeKey
Sink: rememberMeKey assigned from insecure random number
XSS sink: Cookie values (user-controlled) printed directly to HTML response
